## Code Review

This pull request implements a single-use JIT routing label remediation to prevent static-label runner-routing races. It introduces a cryptographically random 256-bit routing label generated by the controller and validated within the isolated workflow. The review feedback highlights several improvement opportunities: guarding against potential null reference exceptions in the `finally` block of `New-ControllerOneTimeRunnerLabel`, preventing strict-mode errors in `Test-ControllerOneTimeRunnerLabel` through null checks or try-catch blocks, and avoiding fragile `JSON.stringify` comparisons for object validation in the workflow checker.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> The [consumer version of Gemini Code Assist on GitHub](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/review-repo-code) is being sunset. Starting **June 18, 2026**, new organization installations will be blocked, and all code review activity will officially cease on **July 17, 2026**.
> For more details on the timeline and next steps, please review the [Help Documentation](https://developers.google.com/gemini-code-assist/docs/deprecations/consumer-code-review).
